verdict.rationale: Supabase provides a managed Postgres database with auto-generated REST/GraphQL APIs, client SDKs, and server-side access via secret keys, backed by extensive docs, CLI, and hands-on probe confirmation (CLI runtime, local init) plus community corroboration of long-term real-world use. missing for 10: independent benchmark/third-party audit of client+server SDK parity across all languages beyond docs.
